about_the_game:
Step into a magical fairy tale world and join little Misha on his heartwarming journey to return home to his mother. In this enchanting platformer, Misha is mysteriously transformed into a bear and transported into a land full of wonders and secrets. Along the way, he will encounter curious characters who each hold a piece of wisdom or guidance. By helping them with their troubles, Misha uncovers clues about how to become a boy again and find the path back to his beloved mom. Adventure, friendship, and a touch of magic await in this charming tale of courage and hope.

The player controls the character of little Misha and can move left, right, up and fall down. He uses platforms to get high, but don't worry, he can't get hurt by falling.

The player can talk to various NPCs. Most of the time, they will ask him for a simple task like "bring an item" to tell him useful information or clear the way for him to the next levels.

The player is not in any danger and cannot die. In some levels, it is possible to fall into the abyss if you make a bad jump, but then the player appears at the beginning of the level without any penalty.

The goal is to go through all the levels and get to where Misha can transform and return to his mother.
